R0075.title: Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) Compliance Risk
R0075.definition: Compliance risk in the critical information infrastructure domain refers to the risk that an organization fails to meet relevant regulations and address potential threats in the CII sector.
R0075.description: Scenarios include failure to ensure the security of networks and information systems, non-compliance with national and regional information security regulations, and failure to respond to cyberattacks and data breaches.
R0075.influence: May lead to legal sanctions, service disruptions, information leakage, and public safety risks.

references.title: Regulation on the Security and Protection of Critical Information Infrastructure
Provisions on the Use and Management of Commercial Cryptography in Critical Information Infrastructure

observables: Critical information infrastructure has not completed the security assessment or filing required under CII protection regulations
Network or information systems carry unpatched high-severity vulnerabilities that affect CII business continuity
Data-breach or cyberattack incidents occur at CII operators and are not reported as required
Cryptographic usage fails to comply with commercial-cryptography management regulations, and the migration to national cryptographic algorithms lags behind
